title: Implement lora_recv_async in LICHEN LoRa drivers (prereq for L2 async RX)
description: Bead sb0b's premise 'driver async API already exists' is false: lr1110.c:627, lora_sim.c:433, lora_renode.c:279 all return -ENOTSUP, and lora_loopback.c (ping_l2 RX source) has no recv_async vtable slot at all (NULL fp call). Wiring lichen L2 to lora_recv_async without this work makes every driver deaf - a hardware RX regression (rx_thread polling works today on LR1110). Implement recv_async: LR1110 DIO1 RX_DONE IRQ + RX-continuous re-arm per SX126x/LR1110 datasheet; loopback driver delivers queued packets via registered cb (work-item context); sim/renode at minimum must not silently -ENOTSUP once L2 depends on it. Discovered from sb0b during claim check.
acceptance_criteria: lora_recv_async on each driver delivers frames (loopback: ping_l2 RX path; lr1110: DIO1 IRQ path per datasheet); L2 async tests pass; no NULL recv_async vtable slots remain
